generations.text: Nadia Natarajan contacted support because the Aero 2 shows a blank screen on boot since 2026-03-01. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently Escalated. The agent offered a repair of $310.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-26708 and asked for a refund. The knowledge base notes that Volt Charger stops at 80 percent for 2 hours on a hot day. The customer seems satisfied with the proposed next step.
